newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3910/3.3941 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3910/3.3941 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3890 to 3.3925 pounds bid and 3.3920 to 3.3960 offered in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3910 pounds bid and 3.3941 offered. The averages compared with 3.3903 bid and 3.3930 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at opening as 3.392718 buy and 3.395665 sell.
